mapper.sql: (t.trigger_code NOT IN (0, 200) OR t.handle_code NOT IN (0, 200))
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(t.trigger_time) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN t.trigger_code IN (0, 200) AND t.handle_code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, SUM(CASE WHEN t.trigger_code NOT IN (0, 200) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatchFailed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.trigger_code IN (0, 200) AND t.handle_code NOT IN (0, 200) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS executionFailed, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM xxl_job_log t WHERE GROUP BY DATE(t.trigger_time) ORDER BY day

SELECT ranked.job_group AS jobGroup, ranked.job_id AS jobId, i.name AS jobName, ranked.failed, ranked.attempts, ranked.lastFailure FROM ( SELECT t.job_group, t.job_id, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.trigger_code != 0 OR t.handle_code != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts, MAX(CASE WHEN THEN t.trigger_time END) AS lastFailure FROM xxl_job_log t WHERE GROUP BY t.job_group, t.job_id HAVING failed > 0 ORDER BY failed DESC, lastFailure DESC, t.job_group, t.job_id LIMIT 10 ) ranked LEFT JOIN xxl_job_info i ON i.id = ranked.job_id AND i.job_group = ranked.job_group ORDER BY ranked.failed DESC, ranked.lastFailure DESC, ranked.job_group, ranked.job_id

SELECT CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS logId, t.job_group AS jobGroup, t.job_id AS jobId, i.name AS jobName, t.executor_address AS executorAddress, t.trigger_time AS triggerTime FROM xxl_job_log t LEFT JOIN xxl_job_info i ON i.id = t.job_id AND i.job_group = t.job_group WHERE AND ORDER BY t.trigger_time ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
